messages:
Aisha (CEO): Thanks for joining today. Leaving a short thread to surface any strategy follow-ups we missed  quick Qs only, please.
Priya (sales): First: what's the sharpest 10s answer to "Why Redwood?" for an exec buyer?
Aisha (CEO): "We turn LLMs into a predictable product: consistent latency, transparent unit economics, and deployment choices that meet your SLAs and compliance needs." Outcome-first, then examples.
Nikhil (strategy): For competitive briefs, are we allowed to contrast features like rollout controls and eval monitoring explicitly?
Tom (VP Product): Yes, highlight productized rollouts, canary policies, and continuous quality monitoring. Frame them as capabilities customers get out of box.
Maya (customer-success): Customer question: when should a customer pick Dedicated vs Private? One-liner?
Aisha (CEO): Dedicated = predictable throughput + SLAs; Private = data residency/compliance or air-gapped needs. Start hosted, move when you need isolation.
Jules (research): Roadmap: will we prioritize model-family-specific kernel work or broader autoscaling improvements?
Tom (VP Product): Short: optimize kernels for the top 3 model families we see in production first, then invest in autoscale and cross-region routing.
Priya (sales): Objection line for "we can just self-host"?
Aisha (CEO): "Self-hosting hides years of ops and reliability work. We deliver those primitives so your team can ship features not infra." Keep it empathic.
Nikhil (strategy): Market positioning: should we call ourselves an "inference platform" or "inference runtime" externally?
Tom (VP Product): Public: inference platform (broad). Technical docs can use runtime for precision.
Maya (customer-success): Any approved benchmark tagline for demos? Need one short stat.
Tom (VP Product): Use this vetted line: "Typical production workloads see 2-3x lower per-token cost with caching + batching on Dedicated vs naive endpoints." Cite internal benchmark page.
infra-bot: Slides + recording uploaded: https://internal.redwood.example/all-hands/2960012345 :white_check_mark:
Priya (sales): Thanks  will wait for the battlecard and the sanitized benchmark link.
Aisha (CEO): We'll publish a 1-pager battlecard, SLO templates, and the benchmark link by EOD. If you need roleplay lines, ping me or Tom 1:1. Closing thread.  Aisha
